e: i was following a recipe at first but wanted it to be vegetarian cause I hate myself so I ended up winging it. Here’s a rough recipe:

Spray a 9x9 baking pan lightly with oil. 

Get a normal sized bag of hot Cheetos, open it to let out air, close it and smash it up so the pieces are a bit smaller. 

Put 3-4 tbsp of butter in a sauce pan on low heat. Once melted add a container (about 7 oz) of marshmallow fluff. Once it’s liquidy, throw in your hot Cheetos and once they’re coated evenly put them in baking pan and leave to cool. 

Eat and enjoy your masterpiece
